parameters.content:
## ⚡ content-repurposer — START HERE

Paste one URL → get a Twitter/X thread, 3 LinkedIn posts, and a newsletter blurb in your tone, saved to a Sheet you can copy from.

```
Paste URL (form) → Fetch Source → Extract Text → Generate (Claude) → Split Sections → Save to Sheet
```

### Buyer setup checklist
- [ ] **Generate (Claude)** → add your Anthropic API key as a *Header Auth* credential (see purple sticky)
- [ ] **Save Repurposed Content** → pick Google account + Sheet + tab (`Repurposed`)
- [ ] Edit tone/prompt in *Generate (Claude)* if you want a different style
- [ ] Activate → open the form's *Production URL* → paste a URL → submit

All credentials are placeholders — nothing runs until you connect your own.

## 🔑 LLM key + provider swap

This calls **Anthropic** via a plain HTTP node so it's provider-swappable.

**Add your key:** Credentials → New → **Header Auth** → Name = `x-api-key`, Value = your Anthropic key (`sk-ant-...`). Select it on *Generate (Claude)*.

**Want OpenAI instead?** Change URL to `https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions`, set Header Auth Name = `Authorization`, Value = `Bearer sk-...`, and swap the JSON body to the OpenAI chat shape (BUILD_NOTES has the exact body + the one-line parser change).

Default model: `claude-sonnet-4-6` — edit in the JSON body.

## ⚠️ Content fetch reality

*Fetch Source* works reliably on **public blog / article pages** (HTML).

It does **NOT** reliably get YouTube transcripts (YouTube serves an app shell, not the transcript) or pages behind logins / paywalls / heavy JS / bot-blocks.

For YouTube: paste the transcript text or video description into a blog-style page, or use a transcript provider. Full guidance + what reliably works is in BUILD_NOTES.
